caption: The drawing features two square shapes side by side, each bordered by light beige lines and set against a similarly light beige background. Both squares contain symmetrical, abstract patterns made from a different fabric pattern in each square. The patterns are predominantly red with accents of yellow, blue, green, and black, forming a floral motif. The left square displays four main organic shapes radiating from a small central diamond, with split segments and rounded extensions, resembling stylized leaves or petals. The right square presents a more geometric arrangement, with leaf-like shapes at the corners and diamond shapes aligned with the center, creating a cross-like configuration with a central diamond opening. Each pattern is centered within its square, and the overall layout maintains symmetry. In the bottom right corner of the right square, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is inscribed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Patchwork Squares
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
